episodes.name: January 3, 2026
episodes.overview: All Elite Wrestling kicks off the new year as Darby Allin faces Wheeler Yuta, and Scorpio Sky goes one-on-one against Shelton Benjamin. Don Callis Family member El Clon makes his in-ring debut. The Timeless Love Bombs battle against the rising stars Hyan and Maya World.

episodes.name: January 10, 2026
episodes.overview: The Babes of Wrath (Harley Cameron and Willow Nightingale) join forces with Kris Statlander in six-woman tag team action. Mark Briscoe defends his TNT Championship against the Don Callis Family's Hechicero. El Clon battles Komander.

episodes.name: Maximum Carnage - January 17, 2026
episodes.overview: Maximum Carnage continues on AEW Collision as the World Trios Titles are put on the line: The Opps vs. Hangman Adam Page & JetSpeed. Andrade makes his in-ring return against Angelico. Penelope Ford rejoins Megan Bayne in tag team action. Jungle Jack Perry faces Anthony Bowens to decide the next AEW National Championship challenger. Eddie Kingston & Ortiz versus Grizzled Young Veterans. Don Callis Family battle Sky Flight. FTR has something to say.

episodes.name: January 24, 2026
episodes.overview: Katsuyori Shibata battles Hangman Adam Page. Willow Nightingale defends her TBS Title against Julia Hart. Roderick Strong challenges Claudio Castagnoli for the CMLL World Heavyweight Title. Kris Statlander in action. Andrade El Idolo faces CMLL star Magnus. Paul Wight joins Excalibur and Tony Schiavone on commentary.

episodes.name: January 31, 2026
episodes.overview: "Psycho Killer" Tommaso Ciampa makes his explosive in-ring debut as he challenges Mark Briscoe for his TNT Championship. Babes of Wrath defend their AEW Women's World Tag Team Titles against the Sisters of Sin. Darby Allin faces NJPW's Clark Connors in singles action. The Rascalz step into the AEW ring for the first time to battle CRU.

episodes.name: February 7, 2026
episodes.overview: Wild eight-man parking lot brawl as Eddie Kingston, Ortiz, and The Rascalz face Grizzled Young Veterans, Big Bill, and Bryan Keith. Tommaso Ciampa defends his newly won TNT Title against Roderick Strong and Claudio Castagnoli. Marina Shafir and Wheeler Yuta battle Dante Martin and Zayda Steel in a mixed tag match. Thekla in singles action. Young Bucks face GOA.

episodes.name: Grand Slam Australia 2026
episodes.overview: AEW Grand Slam Australia from Sydney! MJF defends his world title against Brody King. One of the losing team members will sacrifice their hair as Orange Cassidy and Toni Storm battle Marina Shafir and Wheeler Yuta in a tornado match. Newly re-crowned TNT Champion Kyle Fletcher takes on Mark Briscoe in a ladder match. The Babes of Wrath put their Women's World Tag Team titles on the line against Megan Bayne and Penelope Ford. Andrade el Idolo faces Hangman Adam Page to determine who will be the World Title challenger at AEW Revolution.

episodes.name: February 21, 2021
episodes.overview: The AEW Trios titles are on the line as The Demand (Ricochet and GOA) challenge the champions Hangman Adam Page, Kevin Knight, and Speedball Mike Bailey. Thunder Rosa returns to in-ring action against Triangle of Madness' Julia Hart. CMLL World Heavyweight Champion Claudio Castagnoli faces Josh Alexander.

episodes.name: February 28, 2026
episodes.overview: Death Riders brawl with the Don Callis Family in an eight-man match. Tommaso Ciampa faces Jay Lethal. Toni Storm vs. Zayda Steel. Andrade El Ídolo goes one-on-one against Tomohiro Ishii. Kris Statlander and Thunder Rosa team up to face the Sisters of Sin. The Brawling Birds (Alex Windsor & Jamie Hayter) are in action.

episodes.name: March 7, 2026
episodes.overview: Deathriders' Claudio Castagnoli battles Don Callis Family's Konosuke Takeshita. AEW World Tag Team Champions FTR face the Rascalz. Swerve Strickland goes one-on-one against Gravity. Four teams compete for a $200,000 prize: The Outrunners vs. Private Party vs. The Swirl vs. LFI.

episodes.name: March 14, 2026
episodes.overview: Before Sunday's pay-per-view, the road to Revolution runs through San Jose. For the first time ever, Andrade El Idolo battles Máscara Dorada. The Demand faces the Bang Bang Gang. Triangle of Madness in action. Mina Shirakawa vs. Lena Kross. El Clon challenges Kevin Knight.

episodes.name: Collision - Slam Dunk Saturday 2026
episodes.overview: Robbie Eagles challenges Kyle Fletcher for the TNT Championship. The Brawling Birds take on Sisters of Sin. L.F.I. is in Trios Action. Plus, Death Riders battle Komander & Máscara Dorada.

episodes.name: Collision - Slam Dunk Sunday 2026
episodes.overview: Místico & JetSpeed battle Don Callis Family for the AEW World Trios Championship. Orange Cassidy & Roderick Strong face Jay Lethal & Lee Johnson. Divine Dominion is in Action. Plus, Tommaso Ciampa takes on Lio Rush.

episodes.name: March 28, 2026
episodes.overview: All Elite Wrestling is live from Cedar Rapids! Kevin Knight challenges AEW International Champion Kazuchika Okada. Women's World Tag Team Champions Divine Dominion defend their titles against inaugural champions Babes of Wrath. Bang Bang Gang's Ace Austin vs. "The Psycho Killer" Tommaso Ciampa.

episodes.name: April 2, 2026
episodes.overview: The Death Riders and Dogs combine forces to face Kevin Knight, Místico, and the Conglomeration. AEW TBS Champion Willow Nightingale issues an open challenge. Jon Moxley faces Anthony Bowens in an AEW Continental Title Eliminator match. AEW World Tag Team Champions FTR in action. Juice Robinson battles Tomasso Ciampa.

episodes.name: April 11, 2026
episodes.overview: AEW Worlds Trios Titles are on the line as JetSpeed and Místico defend against The Dogs. Kazuchika Okada vs. Myron Reed. Thekla and Marina Shafir join forces to battle the Brawling Birds. Young Bucks vs. Don Callis Family's El Clon and Hechicero. Hurt Syndicate returns to action. Competing for a prime spot in Dynasty's Casino Gauntlet match, Anthony Bowens faces Rush.

episodes.name: Collision: Spring Breakthru 2026
episodes.overview: Thekla defends her AEW Women's World Title against Alex Windsor. Jon Moxley faces Nick Wayne in a Continental Championship Eliminator match. The Rascalz challenge the Young Bucks. The Conglomeration collides with The Lethal Twist. The new alliance of Hikaru Shida and Kris Statlander is tested in tag-team action.

episodes.name: Collision: Playoff Palooza 2026
episodes.overview: The Demand is itching for a fight, but Chris Jericho has rallied The Hurt Syndicate to join him. AEW Tag Team Champions FTR respond to the special challenge laid out by Adam Copeland and Christian Cage for Double or Nothing. The alliance between the Death Riders and the Dogs will leave no man untested as Young Bucks and Rascalz unite in a wild ten-man tag team match.

episodes.name: May 2, 2026
episodes.overview: Kevin Knight defends his TNT title against the cold-hearted, handsome devil Hook. Anna Jay returns to action to challenge Willow Nightingale. The alliance between the Dogs and the Death Riders will be again tested as the factions join forces to battle Top Flight and the Rascalz in a ten-man tag team match. Can Jack Perry handle the high-flying Máscara Dorada?

episodes.name: May 6, 2026
episodes.overview: After defeating both MJF and Hook, the young phenom Kevin Knight believes he's ready to challenge for the AEW World Championship. And AEW World Champion Darby Allin defends against TNT Champion "The Jet” Kevin Knight. Live from North Charleston, South Carolina!

episodes.name: Collision: Fairway to Hell 2026
episodes.overview: After another harrowing title defense on Wednesday, the daredevil Darby Allin is determined to keep fighting, but does he have enough resolve left to defeat PAC? Jack Perry defends his National Title against the Don Callis Family's brute, Mark Davis. Plus, Divine Dominion in tag team action. All Elite Wrestling presents Fairway to Hell from the SoFi Center in Palm Beach Gardens, Florida.

episodes.name: May 16, 2026
episodes.overview: All Elite Wrestling Collision is live from Salisbury, Maryland. Mark Briscoe makes his long-awaited return to the ring with the Conglomeration. AEW Women's Tag Team Champions Divine Dominion are ready for anything and will hold a 5-minute Open Challenge Eliminator.

episodes.name: May 20, 2026
episodes.overview: It's the last stop before Sunday's Double or Nothing pay-per-view! After his shocking attack on Bandido, Swerve Strickland returns to AEW to share what's really going on. Athena & Triangle of Madness battle Thunder Rosa, The Brawling Birds and Mina Shirakawa.

episodes.name: May 27, 2026
episodes.overview: All Elite Wrestling live at the Liacouras Center in Philadelphia for another hour of action. TNT Champion "The Jet" Kevin Knight shares his thoughts following his actions at Sunday's Double or Nothing event. Fresh off Stadium Stampede, "Jungle" Jack Perry goes one-on-one against Mark Davis in the quarterfinals of the Owen Hart Foundation Men's Tournament.

episodes.name: May 30, 2026
episodes.overview: The All Elite Wrestling World Trios Champions are ready to defend their titles as The Conglomeration faces off against the Don Callis Family. After making their surprise return at the Double or Nothing pay-per-view, TayJay will face the Women's World Tag Team Champions, Divine Dominion, in a 5-Minute Tag Team Championship Eliminator match. AEW Collision is live coast-to-coast from Huntsville, Alabama!

episodes.name: June 6, 2026
episodes.overview: AEW Collision is live coast-to-coast as All Elite Wrestling arrives in Youngstown, OH. Last week TayJay proved they're worthy of a Women's World Tag Team Championship match. Now, Anna Jay and Tay Melo will challenge the reigning champions, Divine Dominion. In the quarterfinals of the 2026 Women's Owen Hart Foundation Tournament, STARDOM's Hazuki faces off against CMLL's Persephone.

episodes.name: Collision: Summer Blockbuster 2026
episodes.overview: Summer Blockbuster continues in Cincinnati! Time for a street fight, with Jon Moxley leading the Death Riders against Shane Taylor Promotions. As Kenny Omega prepares for Zack Sabre Jr. at Forbidden Door, first he must face Bad Dude Tito. AEW TBS Title Survival of the Fittest Qualifying Match: Persephone vs. Julia Hart. Also, the Young Bucks take on Clark Connors and David Finlay.

episodes.name: June 20, 2026
episodes.overview: Athena battles Maya World for a spot in the finals of the Owen Hart Foundation Women's Tournament. The Young Bucks and Jack Perry join forces to take on The Lethal Twist. Plus, NJPW technical wizard Zack Sabre Jr. goes one-on-one against Adam Priest, and CMLL star Místico returns to AEW action against Top Flight's Dante Martin.

episodes.name: June 27, 2026
episodes.overview: It's the last stop before Sunday's Forbidden Door and Jericho is in action! The Conglomeration defend the AEW World Trios Titles against The Opps. Ahead of their highly anticipated showdown in the Owen Hart Foundation Women's Tournament finals, Mercedes Moné (teaming with Athena) and Maya World (teaming with Hyan) face off in a massive tag team battle. Místico and Speedball Mike Bailey join forces to face the Premier Athletes.

episodes.name: July 2, 2026
episodes.overview: Adam Copeland, Jay White, and the Gunns join forces to take on Shane Taylor Promotions. Thunder Rosa and Mina Shirakawa are in tag team action. The Rascalz battle Místico, "Speedball" Mike Bailey, and Bandido. Don't miss this special, extended episode of AEW Collision!

episodes.name: July 11, 2026
episodes.overview: The Ring of Honor World Championship is on the line as champion Bandido battles "The Wrestler" Katsuyori Shibata. Fresh off her victory in the Survival of the Fittest match, Hikaru Shida defends her TBS Championship against Harley Cameron. "Speedball" Mike Bailey challenges Mark Davis for the AEW National Title.

episodes.name: July 18, 2026
episodes.overview: Hikaru Shida defends her TBS Championship against Queen Aminata. TNT Champion Kevin Knight faces AR Fox. Mercedes Moné has something to say to her hometown crowd in Boston. Will Ospreay in action. Jack Perry begins the next chapter of his AEW career.

episodes.name: July 25, 2026
episodes.overview: It's the last stop before Sunday's Redemption Pay-Per-View! Young Bucks battle Daniel Garcia and Wheeler Yuta. Willow Nightingale joins forces with Maya World against AEW TBS Champion Hikaru Shida and AEW Women's World Champion Thekla. To qualify for the last two spots in Sunday's ladder match, AR Fox faces Nick Wayne and El Clon faces Lio Rush.

episodes.name: July 30, 2026
episodes.overview: A special Collision features Will Ospreay facing Daniel Garcia following Ospreay's dramatic exit from the Death Riders. Brawling Birds and HAZUKI team against Athena and her M.I.T. Bang Bang Gang looks for revenge against the Death Riders.

episodes.name: August 8, 2026
episodes.overview: The first-ever Continental Challenge Cup kicks off with three opening-round matches: Claudio Castagnoli vs. Ace Austin, Jake Doyle vs. Eddie Kingston, and Orange Cassidy vs. Matt Sydal! Plus, TBS Champion Maya World teams with Hyan against Persephone and Hikaru Shida after what happened at Grand Slam: Mexico, and more!

episodes.name: August 15, 2026
episodes.overview: The Continental Challenge Cup opening round concludes: Conglomeration cohorts Kyle O'Reilly and Roderick Strong collide, Katsuyori Shibata faces Nigel McGuinness, and Don Callis Family members Brian Cage and Hechicero clash. Mercedes Moné is in action against Zayda Steel. AEW World Trios Champions Hangman Page and Brodido defend against The Lethal Twist.

episodes.name: August 22, 2026
episodes.overview: The Continental Challenge Cup Quarterfinals conclude. Only a week before her All In: London match against Mercedes Moné, All Elite Wrestling's Women World Champion Willow Nightingale keeps her word and defends her title against the young rising star TBS Champion Maya World. AEW Collision is live from Reading, Pennsylvania!
